description:
Several structural tests scan the source tree to assert that retired file paths, function names, event tags and a retired CLI verb are absent. Such a test names a property nobody can break by accident, and it outlives the cutover that motivated it.

## Background

In `crates/jit/tests/scratch_build/repository_state_cutover_tests.rs`:

- `test_cutover_has_no_known_predecessor_or_compatibility_module` (`:1283-1352`), with its only helper `contains_cargo_manifest` (`:562-569`).
- The no-retired-selector-bypass test (`:1412-1427`) and the no-retired-profile-applied-event-contract test (`:1430-1438`).
- Their only helpers: `assert_retired_lifecycle_entry_point_absent` (`:169-185`), `assert_retired_profile_applied_contract_absent` (`:186-224`), `generated_event_tags` (`:245-251`).
- The retired-bypass and retired-event-contract cases in `test_profile_lifecycle_structural_guards_reject_their_forbidden_shapes` (`:1555-1590`).

The tests at `:1084,1122,1355,1382,1446,1468,1759,1792,1819,1861`, and the helpers `production_sources` and `definition_owners`, assert current ownership or forbidden capabilities and stay.

Two CLI tests assert that retired verbs are absent:

- `tests/cli_issue/command_alias_tests.rs:99` `test_retired_document_archive_has_no_alias_or_stub` asserts that a retired CLI verb is absent and that no migration hint names it.
- `tests/cli_gate/gate_status_all_strict_test.rs:249` `test_removed_gate_aliases_fail_as_unknown_subcommand` asserts that `pass`, `pass-all`, `check` and `check-all` are absent.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No test asserts the absence of a retired file path, function name, event tag or CLI verb.
- [hard] REQ-02: The structural-guard self-test holds no retired-bypass or retired-event-contract case.
- [hard] REQ-03: The ownership, authority and capability tests in the cutover suite still pass, and each asserts current ownership.

## Notes

Only tests and their now-unused helpers are deleted.
title: Remove source-scan tests for retired names
